npcs.name: Rashid
npcs.location: Travels daily: Mon=Svargrond, Tue=Liberty Bay, Wed=Port Hope, Thu=Ankrahmun, Fri=Darashia, Sat=Edron, Sun=Carlin
npcs.notes: Requires completing The Traveling Trader Quest to access. Travels to a different city each day of the week.

npcs.name: Yasir
npcs.location: Appears randomly in: Ankrahmun, Carlin, Edron, Liberty Bay, Svargrond, Yalahar (check trade channels)
npcs.notes: Buys creature products at high prices. Appears randomly — check Tibia trade channels for sightings.

npcs.name: Haroun
npcs.location: Marid fortress, south of Ankrahmun (Djinn Tower - Blue)
npcs.notes: Requires completing The Djinn War quest (Marid/Blue faction). Cannot access if you chose Efreet/Green faction.

npcs.name: Nah'Bob
npcs.location: Marid fortress, south of Ankrahmun (Djinn Tower - Blue)
npcs.notes: Buys magic items and rods/wands. Requires Marid faction quest.

npcs.name: Yaman
npcs.location: Efreet fortress, north of Ankrahmun (Djinn Tower - Green)
npcs.notes: Requires completing The Djinn War quest (Efreet/Green faction). Cannot access if you chose Marid/Blue faction.

npcs.name: Alesar
npcs.location: Efreet fortress, north of Ankrahmun (Djinn Tower - Green)
npcs.notes: Buys elemental equipment. Requires Efreet faction quest.

npcs.name: Brengus
npcs.notes: Standard bank NPC. Deposit, withdraw, transfer gold, check balance.

npcs.name: Captain Bluebear
npcs.location: Thais harbour, south-east of the city

npcs.name: Cora
npcs.location: Carlin harbour, south of the city

npcs.name: Oriosa
npcs.location: Edron harbour, south of the island

npcs.name: Sam
npcs.notes: Thais armory. Buys/sells basic weapons and armor.

npcs.name: Xodet
npcs.location: Xodet's Magic Shopee, centre of Thais
npcs.notes: Sells wands and rods. Main magic shop in Thais.

npcs.name: Al Dee
npcs.notes: General tools shop in Thais. Sells essential adventuring equipment.

npcs.name: Willard
npcs.notes: Weapon and armor shop in Edron.

npcs.name: Grizzly Adams
npcs.location: Port Hope, north of depot, big building
npcs.notes: Head of the Adventurers' Guild. Gives creature tasks (kill X monsters). Completing tasks awards Paw and Fur points for Charm unlocks.

npcs.name: Lugri
npcs.notes: Quest NPC for Hero Cave access.

npcs.name: A Wrinkled Bonelord
npcs.notes: Key NPC for The Explorer Society quest. Gives access to various explored areas.

npcs.name: Emperor Kruzak
npcs.notes: Part of The New Frontier quest chain.

npcs.name: Jack Fate
npcs.notes: Gives pirate outfit addons and pirate-related quests.

npcs.name: Hugo
npcs.location: Thais Adventurer's Guild (north of the temple)
npcs.notes: Gives various addon quests. Important outfit NPC.

npcs.name: Asima
npcs.notes: Magic shop and potions in Darashia.

npcs.name: Uzgod
npcs.notes: Weapon and armor shop in Kazordoon. Good selection of mid-tier weapons.

npcs.name: Telas
npcs.notes: Magic shop in Ankrahmun. Sells wands, rods, and potions.

npcs.name: Xodet (Runes)
npcs.notes: Rune shop. Sells all commonly used runes.

npcs.name: Briasol
npcs.notes: Equipment shop in Yalahar Trade Quarter.

npcs.name: Henricus
npcs.location: Thais, southeast, near the Tibia temple
npcs.notes: Main NPC for The Inquisition quest. Also gives access to Demon Forge.

npcs.name: Yaman (Task)
npcs.notes: Gives high-level creature tasks (e.g., Demons, Hydras).

npcs.name: Dove
npcs.notes: Sells Amulet of Loss. Also serves as temple healer.

npcs.name: Iwan
npcs.notes: Glooth equipment trader in Rathleton. Buys glooth drops.

npcs.name: Percybald (Postman)
npcs.notes: Post office NPC. Can send letters and parcels after Postman quest.

npcs.name: Cipfried
npcs.notes: Temple NPC in Rookgaard. Heals players.

npcs.name: Obi (Rookgaard)
npcs.notes: Weapon shop in Rookgaard for new players.

npcs.name: Seymour
npcs.notes: Tutorial NPC in Rookgaard Academy. New players start here.
